content.short: Forta is a real-time decentralized cybersecurity network for blockchains.
content.description: Forta is a real-time, decentralized cybersecurity network that runs on Ethereum, Polygon, and other blockchains. Founded in 2021 and incubated by OpenZeppelin, it is trusted by leading dapps such as dYdX, Compound, Lido, and MakerDAO. Backed by thousands of supporters and hundreds of protocols, Forta’s community-run network has protected tens of billions in value from exploits. Web3 teams can subscribe to project-specific security monitoring, while developers can use the Forta SDK to build threat-detection bots and deploy nodes across chains.
